posts.author: Jem
posts.content_md:
Hi Tim

Ahhhhhh.... Feel the peace in the room , we can all talk quietly now, that's much better don't you agree?

As for the books I was trying to ask you tactfully about copyright and i'm glad you've seen the error of your ways. Your intentions were good even if they were misguided.

So, again, welcome to the forum. Another holographer has go to be a good thing. I've only been making holograms for a couple of years myself, and I still have loads to learn. Up to this month i've just been making single beam reflection holograms and playing about with fiber optics. I recently got hold of a small optical table and have been acquiring various optics and mounts. I have to say that my holograms are so much better now i've started to move on to split beam work.

It's all one massive learning curve, but fortunately there are some great folks on this forum (some of whom have brains the size of planets ), who are prepared to help us out. So, ask politely and nicely and i'm sure there will be all the help you could want as you progress to better and better holograms 

Cheers

Jem
